going_concern.quote: Under these circumstances, in accordance with the requirements of Accounting Standards Codification (“ASC”) 205-40, management has concluded that there is substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.equity_line: Also in connection with the Closing, we entered into an ordinary share purchase agreement, dated August 13, 2024 and effective as of August 15, 2024, with White Lion Capital, LLC, which provided us with an equity line of credit (the “ELOC”) of up to $15.0 million.
